about.title: About Me
about.quote: I don't just write code — I build solutions that work.
about.intro: My name is Muzaffarbek Mustafayev. I am a Junior Software Engineer focused on frontend and backend engineering, and a Software Engineering student at Samarkand State University.
about.stack: I build practical web systems with React.js and Node.js, focusing on clean structure, usability, maintainability, and business value.
about.experience: I have hands-on experience building full-stack applications, connecting frontend interfaces with backend services, managing access levels, and developing secure, scalable systems.
about.interests: I value simplifying complex problems, improving system quality, and continuously learning modern software engineering practices. Growth is a daily discipline for me.
about.mission: My goal is to become an engineer who creates simple yet powerful and reliable systems that deliver real value to users.
